verdict.rationale: Grok Bot keeps user memory, files, browser sessions and preferences in its cloud, so data export is a fair question for this product. However, the evidence shows no documented account-wide export, data takeout, or account-deletion path. The CSV/JSON/YAML mention in the files-and-results docs describes file types Bots handle, not an export of the user's data, so it is an adjacent feature and earns no credit. No public API exists either (per the runtime probe).
